article.title: Such condition must not be invalid under section 120.
article.content: In order that a condition that a bequest shall cease to have effect may be valid, it is necessary that the event to which it relates be one which could legally constitute the condition of a bequest as contemplated by section 120.
article.html:
135Such condition must not be invalid under section 120.

Section 135 · Part VI · Chapter XI · page 50 of the Act

In order that a condition that a bequest shall cease to have effect may be valid, it is necessary that the event to which it relates be one which could legally constitute the condition of a bequest as contemplated by section 120.
